reason: I order on Talabat and Noon several times a week and I don't plan ahead, so scanning receipts is one more chore I won't keep up. The free version might get a look, but I wouldn't pay for it.
objection: Another app I have to feed by hand after every shop. The delivery apps already know what I bought, and I never remember to scan.
would_change_my_mind: If it pulled my orders in automatically from Talabat or Noon so I didn't have to scan anything, and the Ramadan recipes felt like what my family cooks.
